title: ehretia thonningiana
intro: Ehretia thonningiana, commonly known as Silver Leaf or African Ehretia, is a plant species native to tropical Africa, belonging to the family Boraginaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Ehretia thonningiana include treating various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, as well as exhibiting potential antiviral and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Ehretia thonningiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic effects.
